_fixture.source: GET /{account}/media/uploads/{upload}/status — SYNTHETIC, hand-built from docs/vendor/onlyfansapi/openapi.json (Get Upload Status, 'Completed POST /media/vault upload' oneOf branch). NOT a live capture.
notes: Bare object (no envelope). For vault uploads the completed payload carries media.id — the reusable vault id — plus credits_used.
Statuses: pending | processing | completed | failed (failed carries error).
